scope: Whenever orders.status is filtered or labeled
description: orders.status is an integer code: 0 = 待付款 (pending payment), 1 = 已付款 (paid), 2 = 已出貨 (shipped), 3 = 已送達 (delivered), 9 = 已取消 (cancelled).

scope: Any order count, revenue, average order value, repeat-customer or channel-share question
description: A valid order has status paid, shipped or delivered (1, 2, 3). Pending-payment (0) and cancelled (9) orders are excluded. In the data, exactly the status 1/2/3 orders carry a successful payment record, which supports this definition.

scope: Any monetary computation based on order_items
description: order_items.unit_price_cents is in 1/100 TWD (cents), while payments.amount_twd and refunds.refund_amount_twd are in TWD. Item amount in TWD = quantity x unit_price_cents / 100. The unit price is the actual transaction price (80-100% of list price), not products.list_price_twd. Unit conversion is required before combining with refunds or payments.

scope: Whenever orders.order_ts is used to define a day, month, quarter or year
description: Per the business glossary, order timestamps are stored in UTC but all operational reports use Taipei time (UTC+8) to assign dates, months, quarters (Q1 = Jan-Mar) and years. The UTC storage itself cannot be verified from the data (hour-of-day is uniform); the glossary is the only source. The shift matters: 13 orders fall outside Taipei year 2025 by UTC bounds and 23 orders change calendar month.

scope: Whenever refunds.refund_ts is used to define a period
description: refund_ts is stored in UTC and reported in Taipei time (UTC+8), per the glossary only. Refund timestamps extend to 2026-01-13, and 3 refunds change calendar month under the +8h shift.

scope: Net revenue for any period, tier, region or channel
description: Net revenue = item amounts of valid orders in the period minus refunds of those same orders. The period is the order creation time (Taipei time); each refund is deducted from its original order regardless of when the refund occurred. 101 of 194 refunds fall in a different Taipei month than their order, so using refund time instead would give a different total.

scope: Average order value for any period
description: Average order value = total item amount of valid orders in the period (refunds NOT deducted) divided by the number of valid orders in the period (Taipei time, order creation time).

scope: Repeat-customer counts per year
description: A repeat customer has at least 2 valid orders within the same Taipei calendar year; orders in other years or non-valid orders do not count. Distinct customers are counted, not orders.

scope: Any question about money received or amounts by payment method
description: Received amount counts only payment records with payment_status = ok. Failed attempts also store a non-zero amount_twd (613 failed rows, e.g. 2.9M TWD for credit_card) and 303 failed attempts belong to valid orders; including them overstates received money.

scope: Refund-report totals by period or category
description: Refund amount in the refund report is attributed to the period of refund occurrence (refund time, Taipei time), which differs from the order-based attribution used for net revenue. For a category breakdown, the category is that of the refunded item's product. Historical questions ('歷史上') span all refunds with no period restriction.

scope: Whenever orders.channel is filtered or labeled
description: orders.channel values: web = 官網, app = 行動 App, store = 實體門市.

scope: Channel-share percentages
description: The share is measured on valid order counts (denominator: all valid orders of the period, numerator: valid orders of the app channel), not on amounts. The glossary does not state the basis of '占比' explicitly; order-count basis is the natural reading of the question wording.

scope: Whenever customers.tier is filtered or labeled
description: customers.tier values: B = 一般會員, S = 銀級會員, G = 黃金會員.

scope: Whenever customers.region_code is filtered or labeled
description: customers.region_code values: TW-N = 北部, TW-C = 中部, TW-S = 南部, JP = 日本, SG = 新加坡. Only TW-N is northern Taiwan; JP and SG are overseas.

scope: Questions that segment historical orders by customer tier or region
description: Tier and region exist only as current values on the customer row (no history, not copied onto orders). Segmenting past orders by tier or region therefore uses the customer's current value; historical tier/region at order time is not recoverable from this data.

scope: Whenever payments.method or payments.payment_status is filtered or labeled
description: payments.method: credit_card = 信用卡, line_pay = LINE Pay, atm = ATM 轉帳, cod = 貨到付款. payments.payment_status: ok = 付款成功, failed = 付款失敗.

scope: Whenever products.category or products.is_active is filtered or labeled
description: products.category: backpack = 登山背包, tent = 帳篷, shoes = 登山鞋, apparel = 機能服飾, accessory = 配件. products.is_active: 1 = 在售 (on sale), 0 = 已下架 (delisted); delisted products still appear in historical order items.

scope: Questions restricted to products currently on sale
description: is_active is a current-state flag with no history. 'Currently on sale' filters on the present flag, while the sales being ranked may include periods before a product was delisted.

scope: Product ranking by units sold
description: The glossary does not define which orders count toward sales quantity. Valid-order quantity is the consistent reading with the valid-order convention. In the construction data, ranking active products by all-order quantity and by valid-order quantity returns the same top product, so the choice did not change the ranking there.

scope: Combining orders with order_items or payments
description: Orders, order items and payment records are different grains: 5238 items over 3000 orders; 244 orders have 2 or 3 payment records (failed attempts plus a success). Order counts must be at order grain and not inflated by item or payment rows; amounts must not be duplicated by multi-row joins.
